description: Gated actions. Each names the effect, the independent observer that confirms it, the authority it needs and the evidence it must carry. The pilot gates only merge_pr.

actions.effect: A pull request is merged into its base branch.
actions.external_observer: Source-host REST API: pull request state and merge commit SHA, reviews bound to the head SHA, check-runs for the head SHA.
actions.required_authority: A merge grant for this agent, repository and base branch, plus an approval from a principal other than the change author on the head SHA being merged.
required_evidence: check-run conclusions for every required check on the head SHA
independent approval bound to the head SHA

actions.effect: A release artifact is deployed to an environment.
actions.external_observer: Deploy system: deployment record and status for the environment, deployed version or artifact digest.
actions.required_authority: A deploy grant for this agent and environment, plus the approval the environment requires from a reviewer other than the requester.
required_evidence: green check-runs for the released SHA

actions.effect: A commit is added directly to a repository's default branch.
actions.external_observer: Source-host REST API: branch ref and commit list of the default branch.
actions.required_authority: An explicit push-to-default grant for this agent and repository; the default is no grant.

actions.effect: A work item is marked closed in the coordination store.
actions.external_observer: Source-host REST API for the PR and its check-runs, and the deploy system when the claimed outcome includes a deploy; the tracker is read back.
actions.required_authority: Close authority for this item; the closing principal is not only the agent that did the work.

actions.effect: A comment, status change or ticket is written to an external tracker.
actions.external_observer: The external tracker's own API, read back after the write.
actions.required_authority: A recorded human go-ahead for this write, target ticket and content class.
